page: OVHcloud d2-8 is a Discovery family virtual server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Haswell processor operating at a clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The instance is configured with 4 shared vCPUs, 4 physical cores, and 1.0 thread per core. It includes 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. Storage is bundled as a 50 GB local NVMe SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark data indicates entry-level performance across compute and memory subsystems. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score of 917.98 falls in the bottom 10%, while the multi-core score of 3730.94 is in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth tests show 322.39 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 35.67 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, both placing in the bottom 25%. Geekbench testing yields a single-core score of 702.0 and a multi-core score of 2064.0, reflecting the shared nature of the underlying processor resources.

Due to the shared CPU allocation and baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps, this instance is designed for low-intensity workloads where resource density and cost efficiency are prioritized over raw performance. It is suited for basic web serving, software compilation testing, and lightweight database operations, as demonstrated by a static web serving throughput of 2.96 GB/sec and a Redis SET performance of 3.03 million operations per second. It is not suitable for high-performance computing, intensive cryptography, or memory-heavy applications.
